ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב אָסַף אֶת בָּנָיו כְּדֵי לְדַבֵּר אִתָּם לִפְנֵי מוֹתוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Jacob calls his sons to gather and tells them about their future. He asks them to listen carefully to his words.

ideas.children_he: גַּם לַבֵּן הַבְּכוֹר יֵשׁ אַחֲרָיוּת עַל מַעֲשָׂיו.
ideas.children_en: Reuben was the oldest son who should lead, but he made a bad mistake and lost his special position.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב בִּקֵּר אֶת הָאַלִּימוּת שֶׁל שִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי.
ideas.children_en: Simeon and Levi acted angrily and cruelly together. Jacob punished them so they would be scattered among their brothers.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב נִבֵּא שֶׁמִּשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ שֶׁל יְהוּדָה תַּנְהִיג.
ideas.children_en: Jacob encourages Judah and says he will be a strong leader. Great rulers, like the Messiah, will come from him.
In Judah's land, there will be plenty of grapes and wine. People there will enjoy abundance and have strong eyes and white teeth.

ideas.children_he: זְבוּלֻן מְקַבֵּל בְּרָכָה שֶׁקְּשׁוּרָה לַיָּם וְלַמִּסְחָר.
ideas.children_en: Zebulun will live by the sea and have trade connections with nearby cities like Sidon.
Issachar is like a strong donkey that rests in fields. He has blessings and a calm life in his land.

ideas.children_he: דָּן מְתֹאָר כְּמִי שֶׁיּוֹדֵעַ לְהִתְמוֹדֵד עִם אוֹיְבָיו.
ideas.children_en: Dan will fight his enemies wisely and get revenge, sometimes in unusual ways.

ideas.children_he: לְכָל שֵׁבֶט יֵשׁ תְּכוּנוֹת וְחֻזְקוֹת מְיֻחָדוֹת.
ideas.children_en: Gad is a brave warrior who hurts his enemies; Asher has fertile land. Naphtali is fast and brings good news.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף עָבַר קְשָׁיִים רַבִּים וּבְכָל זֹאת הִצְלִיחַ לְהִתְחַזֵּק.
ideas.children_en: Joseph is a fruitful tree with all he needs. Though faced with hate, he stayed strong and with God's blessing will grow and get help all his life.
Benjamin is a brave warrior who will win over enemies and share the loot after victory.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב בִּקֵּשׁ שֶׁיִּקְבְּרוּ אוֹתוֹ עִם מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Jacob tells his sons to bury him in the cave in the field of Ephron, the family burial place.

ideas.children_he: מְקוֹם קְבוּרָה מְשֻׁתָּף יָכוֹל לְסַמֵּל קֶשֶׁר בֵּין דּוֹרוֹת.
ideas.children_en: In the cave of Machpelah lie the patriarchs and matriarchs. Jacob asks to be buried there in the empty spot.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב הִזְכִּיר לְבָנָיו שֶׁהַמְּעָרָה נִקְנְתָה כַּדִּין.
ideas.children_en: The cave and field are the family land bought long ago from the Hittites.
After giving his final instructions, Jacob lay down and died, joining his people.
